item.title: BriskDB
item.description:
📝 BriskDB turns ordinary SQLite files into one database with parallel writes, PostgreSQL compatibility, HTTP access, and embedded Rust/Python APIs. Keep inspectable files Every data shard remains a normal SQLite database—no SQLite fork. One engine everywhere.
